title: 雪绒花

sections.evidence: Page 1 Systems 0-1 (mm 0-7). Printed margin label '前奏'. 8-bar instrumental intro in 3/4 waltz time.
Page 1 Systems 2-3 (mm 8-15). Printed margin label '主歌1'. Verse 1: '雪绒花 雪绒花 清晨迎着我开放'. 8 bars.
Page 1 Systems 4-5 (mm 16-23). Printed margin label '主歌2'. Verse 2: '小而白 洁而亮 向我快乐地摇晃'. 8 bars.
Page 1 Systems 6-7 (mm 24-31). Printed margin label '副歌'. Chorus: '白雪般的花儿 愿你芬芳 永远开花生长'. 8 bars.
Page 1 Systems 8-9 (mm 32-39). Printed margin label '主歌3'. Verse 3: '雪绒花 雪绒花 永远祝福我家乡'. 8 bars.
Page 2 Systems 10-11 (mm 40-47). Printed margin label '主歌1' on chord-only 弹唱版. 8 bars.
Page 2 Systems 12-13 (mm 48-55). Printed margin label '主歌2' on chord-only 弹唱版. 8 bars.
Page 2 Systems 14-15 (mm 56-63). Printed margin label '副歌' on chord-only 弹唱版. 8 bars.
Page 2 Systems 16-17 (mm 64-71). Printed margin label '主歌3' on chord-only 弹唱版. 8 bars.

uncertain: Page 2 is a separate 弹唱版 (chord-only arrangement) of the same song appended as page 2. Annotations include both pages mapped to global measure indices 0-71.
notes: Page 1 (mm 0-39) is 专业版; Page 2 (mm 40-71) is 弹唱版. All section labels are explicitly printed in the score margins.
